title: FolderNest v2.1.1 Stability & Safety Update
changelog: • Fixed: Recent client and root folder history is no longer lost when a name or path contains [ ] brackets.
• Safer Install: FolderNest now always installs into its own 'FolderNest' folder.
• Safer Uninstall: Uninstalling removes only FolderNest's own files and never touches your other files.
• Smarter Updates: Updates install into your existing FolderNest folder instead of creating a second copy.
• Verified Updates: Downloaded updates are checked with a SHA-256 fingerprint before they run.
• Date Fix: The DD-MMM-YYYY format now always uses English month names (e.g. 24-Nov-2026), whatever your Windows language.
• Correct version number shown in the User Guide and About windows.
• New: FolderNest is now available for macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel).
